svg.title: Distributed tracing across three apps with Dapr
svg.desc: Four things on one line: App A, App B, a message broker and App C, each app drawn as a hexagon with its Dapr sidecar. App A and App B call each other sidecar to sidecar through service invocation. App B's sidecar publishes to the broker and App C's sidecar subscribes to it. Below the row, all three sidecars send the W3C tracing context down onto one line that enters a dashed area of backend monitoring tools: the line from App B drops straight down, and the lines from App A and App C turn onto it with two rounded elbows each. The area holds the Zipkin, Jaeger, New Relic and Datadog marks and the words "and more". Beside it a second dashed area, Visualize, holds three small hexagons in the colours of the three apps joined by arrows: one trace running through App A, App B and App C.
